content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Pregestimil is a ready‑to‑feed infant formula designed for newborns with increased nutritional needs, including preterm infants, low‑birth‑weight babies, and those with digestive sensitivities. It contains easily digestible proteins, DHA, ARA, and prebiotics to support gut microbiota.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is specifically engineered for infants who have limited tolerance to standard formulas.
It includes a lactulose‑derived prebiotic that promotes the growth of beneficial bacteria.
Enfamil Pregestimil has undergone clinical trials demonstrating its effectiveness in weight gain for preterm infants.
Available in 380 ml ready‑to‑feed bottles, convenient for daily hospital use.
Enriched with B‑vitamins, iron, and zinc to support overall development.

items.title: Supports growth and weight gain
items.content: A balanced ratio of protein, fat, and carbohydrates provides the energy and building blocks needed for rapid growth in preterm infants.

items.title: Contains DHA and ARA
items.content: Omega‑3 and omega‑6 fatty acids aid brain and visual system development.

items.title: Easily digestible proteins
items.content: Hydrolyzed proteins reduce the workload on an immature gastrointestinal tract.

items.title: Supports gut microbiota
items.content: Prebiotics stimulate beneficial bacteria, lowering the risk of dysbiosis.

items.title: Enriched with micronutrients
items.content: Vitamins and minerals (vitamin D, iron, zinc) contribute to overall physiological development.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with confirmed cow’s milk or whey protein allergy should use hypoallergenic formulas.

items.title: Heat exposure
items.content: Store the formula in a cool place; temperatures above 25 °C shorten shelf life.

items.title: Expiration control
items.content: After opening, use within 48 hours and keep refrigerated.

items.title: Does not replace breastfeeding
items.content: The product is intended to supplement or replace breast milk only under medical guidance.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the ready‑to‑feed formula in a sterile nipple at body temperature (about 37 °C). Before use, gently shake the bottle, check for any sediment or off‑odor. If warming is needed, place the bottle in warm water; do not use a microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened bottles in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 48 hours. Discard if the product changes color, odor, or taste.
